kjv: neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, [what] he hath prepared for him (KJV 64:4)
mine: no eye has seen a God besides You, Who acts for those Who wait for Him
note: Hebrew 'ayin lo'-ra'atah 'elohim zulatekha ya'aseh: "no eye has seen a God except you, who acts..."; the KJV takes 'elohim as a vocative and supplies "what he hath prepared" (as Paul paraphrases in 1 Cor 2:9).

kjv: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved (KJV 64:5)
mine: in our sins we have been a long time, and shall we be saved?
note: Hebrew bahem 'olam wenivvashea' is obscure; most read it as a despairing question ("shall we be saved?"); the KJV's confident statement reverses the tone.
